lines.text: Warm little fire glowing bright, chasing away the chilly night!
Snap, crackle, pop! What makes wooden logs pop and spark inside the fireplace?
Even dry firewood has tiny droplets of water and tree sap trapped deep inside!
Wood is made of microscopic cellulose straws that once carried water up the tree!
As fierce fire heats the log, that trapped water boils and turns into expanding steam!
The steam expands over a thousand times, building immense pressure inside the wood tube!
Bam! The wood pocket bursts open with a loud pop, releasing a dancing spark!
Now you know the cozy physics behind your crackling winter fire!
